title: Miracle Prep for Plasmid Isolation
author: Blake Flood
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8p2hvqe
materials: 2 mL Buffer P2 (invert 3-4 times) Buffer P2 Qiagen Catalog #19052
2 mL Buffer N3 (invert 3-4 times) Buffer N3 Qiagen Catalog #19064
Re-load and re-spin until everything is loaded.
500 µL Buffer PB to each column Buffer PB Qiagen Catalog #19066

steps.title: Inoculate Culture
steps.instruction: Pick a colony from a plate and inoculate 50 mL of LB broth per vector.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Spin the culture for 10 minutes at 4000 x g and 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 2 mL of Buffer P1 (Qiagen Catalog #19051).

steps.title: Incubate Sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Centrifuge Sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample for 10 minutes at 13200 x g.

steps.title: Prepare for Loading
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant and add 1 volume of 96% EtOH, then mix.

steps.title: Load onto Spin Columns
steps.instruction: Load the mixture onto 4 x “QIAprep 2.0 spin columns” or any generic silica membrane mini spin column (Econospin).

steps.title: Wash Columns
steps.instruction: Perform three consecutive spins for 1 minute each at 17900 x g.

steps.title: Dry Membrane
steps.instruction: Spin again to dry for 1 minute at 17900 x g.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid
steps.instruction: Elute the plasmid using 30-50 uL H2O.

steps.title: Increase Yield (Optional)
steps.instruction: To increase yield, re-load H2O on the columns and re-spin for 1 minute at 17900 x g.
